name: shopping-copilot
description: AI shopping agent: conversational product discovery over the DummyJSON catalog

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @shopping-copilot/api && npm run build -w @shopping-copilot/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @shopping-copilot/api
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @shopping-copilot/api
scripts.eval: npm run build:shared && npm run eval -w @shopping-copilot/api
scripts.simulate: npm run build:shared && npm run simulate -w @shopping-copilot/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @shopping-copilot/api && npm run typecheck -w @shopping-copilot/web
